title: Twin Composition Snapshot
description: The lockfile of a resolution: which model versions were live, pinned by identity of meaning. Each resolved entry pins registry id, version and the Semantic Fingerprint per ARCH-009; the fingerprint is the semantic pin, and byte-level identifiers (source_ref, edges_hash) are clearly labeled non-semantic transport-integrity fields. source_ref is optional: a snapshot pins id, version and fingerprint, and may additionally record the source fetch point. Aligned with the ARCH-016 snapshot marking rules. snapshot_id is derived deterministically over the resolved set, the edges hash and the task_ref, never random; created_at is supplied from resolver input, never from a wall clock. Replay property: the same snapshot rebuilds the same context pack. Availability contract: a pinned snapshot remains valid offline for the declared freshness window of its members (last-known-good); new resolutions during an outage reuse the last-known-good snapshot inside its freshness window, else hard fail. Snapshots also serve composition-level time travel: which model versions were live at time T. Inlined for offline validation: resolved ids use the inlined registry id pattern rather than a remote reference.

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier of this snapshot, derived deterministically over the resolved set, the edges_hash and the task_ref. Never reused, never random.

id.description: Registry id of the resolved model. Inlined id shape.

semantic_fingerprint.description: Semantic Fingerprint per ARCH-009 over the MUIF canonical form. The semantic pin.

source_ref.description: Optional: the source repository ref (tag or commit) the model was fetched at. Non-semantic transport-integrity field; git commit identifiers suffice as provenance in v0.1.

resolved.description: Exactly one entry per resolved model major identity: the result of Minimal Version Selection.

edges_hash.description: Digest of the canonicalized MMDG edge file at resolution time, sha256 over the canonical form with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace. Non-semantic transport-integrity field, never a semantic pin.

created_at.description: When the snapshot was created, supplied from resolver input, never a wall clock.

task_ref.description: Optional reference to the task descriptor whose resolution produced this snapshot.
